detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name: Modular Peptide System B – Pure Peptide Gel

Module Classification: Concentrated Module

Product Information:

  • Formulation Type: Peptide Gel
  • Volume: 20 mL
  • pH Range: 5.0–6.0
  • Packaging: Opaque Airless UV-Protective Container
  • Testing Methodology: HPLC-UV-MS
  • Analytical Verification: ISO/IEC 17025 Accredited Laboratory
  • System Compatibility: Phase 2, Complete Configuration, Standalone Evaluation

Analytical Composition:

  • Palmitoyl Tripeptide-38: 0.20%
  • Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7: 0.03%
  • Total Peptide Content: 0.23%

Product Description:

Module B is one of five products within PHP’s Modular Peptide System, a modular framework of peptide formulations designed for research evaluation. Researchers may evaluate individual modules independently or as part of three structured configurations: Phase 1, Phase 2, or the Complete Configuration.

Module B is a concentrated peptide gel built around Palmitoyl Tripeptide-38 at elevated concentration, with Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7 serving as a supporting peptide. The composition establishes a distinctly elevated peptide profile within a controlled gel matrix designed for concentrated evaluation contexts.

Composition is independently verified through ISO/IEC 17025-accredited analytical testing using HPLC-UV-MS methodology. Batch-specific Certificates of Analysis are available through the COA-Topicals library.

Research Framework:

  • Elevated-concentration peptide composition
  • Dual-peptide architecture with a dominant primary peptide
  • Distinct gel matrix within the modular framework
  • Compatible with Phase 2 and Complete Configuration
  • May be evaluated independently or alongside Module D

Formulation Characteristics:

  • Palmitoyl Tripeptide-38 serves as the primary peptide component at 0.20%
  • Supporting peptide maintained at 0.03% to preserve a defined dual-peptide composition
  • Structurally distinct gel matrix compared to the serum-emulsion systems used elsewhere in the framework
  • Enables comparative evaluation across both peptide concentration and delivery vehicle variables
  • Airless packaging supports compositional integrity and minimizes environmental exposure

Comparative Position Within The System:

Within the modular framework, Module B functions as the concentrated composition. It represents one of the highest-concentration peptide formulations in the system and is analytically paired with Module D, as both products utilize elevated-concentration, single-peptide-dominant architectures while representing distinct chemistry classes.

Compliance Notice:

Modular Peptide System B is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY — NOT FOR HUMAN OR VETERINARY USE. This product is not a drug, cosmetic, food, or dietary supplement and has not been evaluated or approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. It is intended solely for lawful in vitro research and not for any human or animal use. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used exclusively for lawful in vitro research in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, and assumes all responsibility for any use inconsistent with this notice.
